meta.source: Join of research/data/factors.json with first-party site datasets
meta.method: Each measurement is a boolean predicate per site; n excludes sites where the underlying field is null (not measured). 'direct' predicates test the factor's own claim; 'proxy' predicates are weaker stand-ins with the gap stated in `caveat`. Homepage-only except deep-pages (one inner page per site, chosen by nav heuristic). One vantage point, one identifying UA.

factors.label: Robots.txt allows the search and AI retrieval crawlers

measurements.label: No search/retrieval crawler is hard-blocked at the root
measurements.predicate: none of OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, Claude-SearchBot, Claude-User, PerplexityBot, Perplexity-User, Googlebot, Bingbot resolves to 'block'

factors.label: Three crawler classes are three separate decisions

measurements.label: Blocks at least one training crawler while keeping search crawlers open
measurements.predicate: ≥1 training token blocked AND no search/retrieval token blocked
measurements.caveat: Measures a differentiated policy exists, not that it matches the site's intent.

factors.label: XML sitemap covers all indexable pages

measurements.label: Publishes an XML sitemap
measurements.predicate: Sitemap: line in robots.txt or valid /sitemap.xml
measurements.denominator: sites where the sitemap check ran
measurements.caveat: Presence only — says nothing about coverage or lastmod accuracy.

factors.label: No bot wall in front of AI crawlers

measurements.label: Homepage readable over plain HTTP (no bot wall or empty shell blocking non-browser fetches)
measurements.denominator: all crawled sites not excluded by robots.txt
measurements.caveat: Single vantage point and one UA; some walls are UA- or IP-specific.

factors.label: Main content ships in server-rendered HTML

measurements.label: ≥80% of rendered words are present in raw HTML
measurements.caveat: Threshold is ours; the factor says 'main content', we compare all visible words.

measurements.label: ≥80% of rendered headings are present in raw HTML

factors.label: JSON-LD present in raw HTML (not injected client-side)

measurements.label: JSON-LD is in raw HTML (none injected only by JavaScript)
measurements.denominator: measured homepages that have JSON-LD after render

factors.label: Organization schema with @id, logo, sameAs chain

measurements.label: Homepage declares Organization (or Corporation) JSON-LD
measurements.caveat: Type presence only; @id, logo and sameAs chain not checked.

factors.label: Breadcrumbs in HTML plus BreadcrumbList schema

measurements.label: Inner page has HTML breadcrumb navigation
measurements.predicate: breadcrumb nav/ol present in raw HTML
measurements.denominator: sites with an audited inner page
measurements.caveat: HTML half only; BreadcrumbList schema measured separately (breadcrumb-schema-home).

measurements.label: Homepage declares BreadcrumbList JSON-LD
measurements.caveat: Homepages rarely need breadcrumbs; see inner-page measurement.

factors.label: Comparison tables for 'X vs Y' and 'best of' queries

measurements.label: Inner page contains an HTML table
measurements.denominator: sites with an audited inner page
measurements.caveat: Inner page chosen by nav heuristic, not a comparison page.

factors.label: FAQ block whose text matches its schema byte-for-byte

measurements.label: Inner page has FAQ-style markup (details/summary or question headings)
measurements.denominator: sites with an audited inner page
measurements.caveat: Presence only; byte-parity with FAQPage schema not checked.

factors.label: Single H1 and valid heading sequence (no skipped levels)

measurements.label: Inner page has exactly one H1 and no skipped heading levels
measurements.denominator: sites with an audited inner page

factors.label: Unique title, H1, and meta description matched to intent

measurements.label: Inner page has exactly one H1
measurements.denominator: sites with an audited inner page
measurements.caveat: Does not check title/H1/intent match or uniqueness.

factors.label: Descriptive alt text on content images

measurements.label: ≥90% of inner-page images have alt text
measurements.caveat: Presence of alt attribute, not descriptiveness.

measurements.label: Homepage sends a Last-Modified header
measurements.caveat: Weak proxy: dateModified in markup and visible 'last updated' text are not checked; many CDNs omit the header.

factors.label: Core Web Vitals within budget (LCP ≤ 2.5s, INP ≤ 200ms, CLS ≤ 0.1 at p75)

measurements.label: Homepage responds in ≤800 ms
measurements.caveat: TTFB from one location, NOT Core Web Vitals. Use CrUX for the real thing.

measurements.label: Homepage does not use nosnippet / data-nosnippet
measurements.caveat: Does not check noindex or index status.
